en.shortDescription: 24-port managed PoE+ switch for business networks.
en.description:
## Cisco CBS350-24P

A 24-port managed Layer 2/3 switch with PoE+ on every port, built for growing business networks.

- 24× Gigabit PoE+ ports, 195 W PoE budget
- 4× 1G SFP uplinks
- Web-based management and VLAN support
